parameters.content:
## Full candidate integration coverage — no samples
Inventory every configured agent, MCP assignment, model, Citadel link, and Tailscale link. OpenClaw applies per-agent MCP selection; Hermes retains global MCP access.
Real tool/model requests and every link must work. Missing coverage or NOT_TESTED blocks latest promotion. Each PDF section contains the full itemized results plus a short Astra summary.
After each container start/recreation, wait a full 5 minutes for ALL services before ANY health, readiness, port, CLI, model, MCP, Citadel, Tailscale or other runtime test. Record startup and test timestamps. OpenClaw initially builds its model catalog; record first and repeated calls separately. Preserve actual failures and NOT_TESTED; do not infer a source defect from startup delay.

## Fedora45 upgrade loop
Manual execution when a real upgrade is available. Deterministic host adapters via SSH; builds and pulls via mcp-safrano9999. Original volumes. No installation test run.
One final Astra summary/PDF. SOT/source diffs always require prior explicit user Go.

## 1. Check generators first, then freeze the baseline
Update yes → read-only OpenClaw/Hermes generator prechecks → stable tags and local pull → stable Quadlets → daemon-reload without restart → unchanged baseline → generator preparation below → remaining preflight and atomic commit.

## Build → pull → real instance → wait → tests
Build fixed candidates without moving latest. Pull them, recreate the actual instance with its existing volumes, wait until this start is 5 minutes old, then run bounded checks. No copied volumes or second test instance. No LLM grading.

## Promote the tested running image
After all mandatory live checks and health checks pass: verified → latest → Quadlet latest → daemon-reload. No second restart. Every live-check failure restores stable.

## 4. Rollback and failure outcomes
Stable Quadlets → daemon-reload → recreate stable → WAIT 5 MINUTES for ALL services → recovery health check → original recovery gate → final report.

## 5. Bounded repair proposals
Validation failure → bounded proposal → deterministic verification → explicit user review/Go → adoption. Keep every attempt in run.events.
All SOT and source-code changes ALWAYS require prior discussion and the user's explicit Go for the exact proposed diff, through the Telegram main agent. This includes SCRIPTS/config.sh, hardlinks, OpenClaw, Hermes, generators and repair scripts. An LLM cannot approve or apply a change autonomously. Initial model-catalog loading or first-call slowness alone never justifies a source patch.
